note: Byte-for-byte extracts from Carlos Cabrales, Shattered and Reforged (Google Docs/docx on his Drive, exported 2026-11-25) — never retype; regenerate via extraction if the manuscript changes. Multi-paragraph quotes are joined with a single space, per the withPullquote precedent.

quotes.text: You weren’t weak. You were just waiting to be reforged.
quotes.source: Shattered and Reforged — Dedication (book front matter)
quotes.caption: From the dedication of Shattered and Reforged, his book in progress
quotes.placement: about, after the 'What This Is' section

quotes.text: In tech, a crash is just a system’s cry for help. It’s not failure—it’s a call for repair.
quotes.source: Shattered and Reforged — Chapter One: The Day I Crashed
quotes.caption: From Shattered and Reforged, Chapter One

quotes.text: This song became my voice when I had none.
quotes.source: Shattered and Reforged — Chapter One (introducing the song)
quotes.caption: From Shattered and Reforged, Chapter One
quotes.placement: about, closing section 'From the book, from the songs'

lines: No more silence, no more shame,
I'm taking back my life, reclaiming my name.
quotes.source: “Shattered and Reforged” — song lyrics (chorus), as printed in the book, Chapter One; song on My Unspoken Journey
quotes.caption: From “Shattered and Reforged,” the song
quotes.placement: about, closing section 'From the book, from the songs'

quotes.text: You’re still here. There’s still more for you.
